en-US.description: The solution for high-end input devices.
en-US.longDescription:
The CHERRY UTILITY software is the solution for professionals, enthusiasts and gamers with a compatible CHERRY product. Lighting control, macro programming and numerous detailed settings allow you to customize your hardware.
Individual assignment of all keys: Program your CHERRY keyboard/mouse to suit your taste: shortcuts, text modules, macros, open files/folders/programs/websites, multimedia.
Fine-tuned lighting control: Choose from countless colors and lighting effects and create your own lighting concept.
ProScroll Technology: With roughly 288 million possible combinations, ProScroll offers an unprecedented level of customization for a scroll wheel. Combine seven adjustable parameters to create a scrolling experience tailored precisely to your needs.
Works with dedicated CHERRY keyboards and mice: You can use CHERRY UTILITY to directly reprogram your CHERRY keyboard or mouse. The personalized settings are stored directly in the input device. This means that no software needs to be running actively in the background.
en-US.name: CHERRY Utility Software

zh-CN.description: 兼容各种 CHERRY 产品的高端输入设备解决方案
zh-CN.longDescription:
CHERRY Utility 实用软件是一个兼容各种 CHERRY 产品的高端输入设备解决方案，适用与对于产品不太了解的新手或专业人士，具有灯光控制，宏编程和许多详细设置功能，允许您自定义您的硬件。
按键功能单独分配：可以根据您的需求，对您的 CHERRY 键盘/鼠标按键进行编程，分配不一样的功能，例如：文本模块，宏命令，打开文件程序/网站，多媒体等。
丰富的灯光设置：可以随意设置每个键盘按键的灯光颜色，打造属于你独一无二的键盘灯效。
打造你的专属 CHERRY 键鼠：您可将所有个性化设置直接存储在你的 CHERRY 键盘或鼠标中，更换电脑设备也能继续使用，而不必每次打开软件进行设置。
